      revision INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"card_moc_refs","tbl_name":"card_moc_refs","sql":"CREATE TABLE card_moc_refs(moc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_mocs(id),moc_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES private_cards(id),card_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,body_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(moc_id,card_id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"card_moc_title_sources","tbl_name":"card_moc_title_sources","sql":"CREATE TABLE card_moc_title_sources(moc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_mocs(id),
      card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES private_cards(id),card_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,body_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(moc_id,card_id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"card_mocs","tbl_name":"card_mocs","sql":"CREATE TABLE card_mocs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(level IN (1,2)),title TEXT NOT NULL,canonical_title TEXT NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE(owner_id,scope,project_id,level,canonical_title)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"card_note_usage","tbl_name":"card_note_usage","sql":"CREATE TABLE card_note_usage (
      owner_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_count>=0)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"card_notes","tbl_name":"card_notes","sql":"CREATE TABLE card_notes (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('available','deleted')),
      text TEXT, byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT,
      received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK((state='available' AND text IS NOT NULL) OR
        (state='deleted' AND text IS NULL AND byte_count=0))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"card_operations","tbl_name":"card_operations","sql":"CREATE TABLE card_operations (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      action_id TEXT NOT NULL, method TEXT NOT NULL, payload_binding TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_id TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,action_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"card_raw_bindings","tbl_name":"card_raw_bindings","sql":"CREATE TABLE card_raw_bindings (
      card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES private_cards(id), binding_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      start INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start>=0), end INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(end>start),
      source_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(source_ref)),
      position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position BETWEEN 0 AND 15),
      PRIMARY KEY(card_id,binding_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"card_raw_mutation_context","tbl_name":"card_raw_mutation_context","sql":"CREATE TABLE card_raw_mutation_context (
      singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, action_id TEXT NOT NULL
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"card_raw_pending_invalidations","tbl_name":"card_raw_pending_invalidations","sql":"CREATE TABLE card_raw_pending_invalidations (
      card_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES private_cards(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"confirmation_actions","tbl_name":"confirmation_actions","sql":"CREATE TABLE confirmation_actions (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      action_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload_digest TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,action_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"confirmation_conflicts","tbl_name":"confirmation_conflicts","sql":"CREATE TABLE confirmation_conflicts (
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id), memory_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      target_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id), target_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      source TEXT NOT NULL, drop_reason TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','applied','dropped')), result TEXT,
      PRIMARY KEY(memory_id, target_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"confirmation_supersessions","tbl_name":"confirmation_supersessions","sql":"CREATE TABLE confirmation_supersessions (
      previous_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id), previous_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      replacement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id), replacement_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      receipt_ids TEXT NOT NULL, previous_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, previous_receipt_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','unresolved','applied','dropped')),
      result TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(previous_id, replacement_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"episode_attempts","tbl_name":"episode_attempts","sql":"CREATE TABLE episode_attempts(episode_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_episodes(id),
      marker TEXT NOT NULL, watermark INTEGER NOT NULL, token TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL, source_fence INTEGER NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL,
      finished INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(finished IN (0,1)), started INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(started IN (0,1)), outcome_code TEXT
      CHECK(outcome_code IN ('episode_failed','episode_timeout','invalid_model_output',
        'context_budget_exceeded','capacity','expired','generation_conflict','missing_evidence'))
      CHECK(outcome_code IS NULL OR finished=1), PRIMARY KEY(episode_id,marker)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"episode_controls","tbl_name":"episode_controls","sql":"CREATE TABLE episode_controls(owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      generation TEXT NOT NULL, paused INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(paused IN (0,1)),
      enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      CHECK(scope IN ('personal','project')), CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR
  (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)), PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"episode_events","tbl_name":"episode_events","sql":"CREATE TABLE episode_events(
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, client TEXT NOT NULL,event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      episode_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_episodes(id), payload_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_digest)=64 AND payload_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      position INTEGER NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL,
      staging TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(staging IN ('staged','not-staged')), gap TEXT,
      gap_reasons TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(gap_reasons) AND json_type(gap_reasons)='array' AND length(gap_reasons)<=1024),
      admission TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reserved' CHECK(admission IN ('reserved','pending','completed')),
      disposition INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(disposition IN (0,1)), policy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK(policy IN ('normal','skip-quick','explicit-keep')),
      policy_revision INTEGER, policy_type TEXT, policy_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, message_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
      CHECK(json_valid(message_ids) AND json_type(message_ids)='array' AND json_array_length(message_ids)<=24 AND length(message_ids)<=32768), omitted_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(omitted_count BETWEEN 0 AND 24), omitted_indices TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
      CHECK(json_valid(omitted_indices) AND json_type(omitted_indices)='array' AND length(omitted_indices)<=100),
      CHECK(scope IN ('personal','project')), CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR
  (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)), PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id), UNIQUE(episode_id,position),
      FOREIGN KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id) REFERENCES admission_claims(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"episode_identity","tbl_name":"episode_identity","sql":"CREATE TABLE episode_identity(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), secret TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(secret)=64 AND secret NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"episode_keep_actions","tbl_name":"episode_keep_actions","sql":"CREATE TABLE episode_keep_actions (
      admission_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(admission_key)=64 AND admission_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      action_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(action_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
      episode_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_episodes(id),
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_digest)=64 AND payload_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','pending','completed')),
      token TEXT, lease_expires_at INTEGER, memory_ids TEXT, suppressed_count INTEGER,
      keep_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(keep_state IN ('pending','completed','failed','retryable')),
      keep_error_code TEXT CHECK(keep_error_code IS NULL OR length(keep_error_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
      keep_source_ids TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(keep_source_ids) AND json_type(keep_source_ids)='array'
        AND json_array_length(keep_source_ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 16),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), source_fence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_fence>0),
      keep_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(keep_ordinal>0), keep_created_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(keep_created_at)=24),
      UNIQUE(episode_id,action_id), UNIQUE(episode_id,keep_ordinal), CHECK(scope IN ('personal','project')), CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR
  (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)),
      CHECK((state='reserved' AND token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND memory_ids IS NULL AND suppressed_count IS NULL) OR
        (state='pending' AND token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND memory_ids IS NULL AND suppressed_count IS NULL) OR
        (state='completed' AND token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND memory_ids IS NOT NULL
          AND length(memory_ids)<=2016 AND suppressed_count IS NOT NULL AND suppressed_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5)),
      CHECK((keep_state='failed' AND keep_error_code IS NOT NULL) OR (keep_state!='failed' AND keep_error_code IS NULL))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"episode_memory_links","tbl_name":"episode_memory_links","sql":"CREATE TABLE episode_memory_links(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_episodes(id),
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id), event_id TEXT NOT NULL, admission_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, receipt_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE(episode_id,event_id,memory_id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"episode_messages","tbl_name":"episode_messages","sql":"CREATE TABLE episode_messages (
    episode_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_episodes(id),
    message_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(message_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(digest)=64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    first_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    coverage_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(episode_id,message_id)
  ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"episode_sources","tbl_name":"episode_sources","sql":"CREATE TABLE episode_sources(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_episodes(id),
      origin_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_episodes(id), event_id TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(digest)=64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user','assistant')), text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(text)<=800),
      truncated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(truncated IN (0,1)), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"evidence_mappings","tbl_name":"evidence_mappings","sql":"CREATE TABLE evidence_mappings(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('proposed','active','removed')),
      level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(level IN (1,2)),memory_moc_id TEXT NOT NULL,memory_moc_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      card_moc_id TEXT NOT NULL,card_moc_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,memory_index_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      card_index_revision INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"index_edges","tbl_name":"index_edges","sql":"CREATE TABLE index_edges (generation TEXT NOT NULL, parent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      child_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, child_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(generation,parent_id,child_id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"index_generations","tbl_name":"index_generations","sql":"CREATE TABLE index_generations (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      captured_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, page_limit INTEGER NOT NULL,
      phase INTEGER NOT NULL, last_key TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
      published INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"index_memories","tbl_name":"index_memories","sql":"CREATE TABLE index_memories (generation TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(generation,id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"index_memory_refs","tbl_name":"index_memory_refs","sql":"CREATE TABLE index_memory_refs (generation TEXT NOT NULL, moc_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL, moc_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, memory_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(generation,moc_id,memory_id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"index_mocs","tbl_name":"index_mocs","sql":"CREATE TABLE index_mocs (generation TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(generation,id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"index_title_sources","tbl_name":"index_title_sources","sql":"CREATE TABLE index_title_sources (generation TEXT NOT NULL, moc_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL, memory_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(generation,moc_id,memory_id)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"local_capture_controls","tbl_name":"local_capture_controls","sql":"CREATE TABLE local_capture_controls (
    owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('personal','project')), project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    client TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(client IN ('claude-code','codex')), target_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), automatic_capture_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(automatic_capture_enabled IN (0,1)),
    consent_generation TEXT NOT NULL, raw_notice_version TEXT CHECK(raw_notice_version='local-plain-v1'),
    CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)),
    PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client)
  ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"memories","tbl_name":"memories","sql":"CREATE TABLE memories (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('personal','project')),
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('explicit','agent-inferred')),
      confidence REAL NOT NULL CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
      deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (deleted IN (0,1)),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, filing_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unfiled'
      CHECK (filing_status IN ('filed','unfiled')), currentness TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'current'
    CHECK (currentness IN ('current','historical')), review_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none'
      CHECK(review_state IN ('none','awaiting','confirmed')),
      CHECK ((scope = 'personal' AND project_id = '') OR
             (scope = 'project' AND length(project_id) > 0)),
      CHECK ((deleted = 0 AND content IS NOT NULL) OR (deleted = 1 AND content IS NULL))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"memory_conflicts","tbl_name":"memory_conflicts","sql":"CREATE TABLE memory_conflicts (
      left_memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      left_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (left_revision > 0),
      right_memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      right_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (right_revision > 0),
      relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relation = 'contradicts'),
      source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('explicit-hint','inferred-hint')),
      PRIMARY KEY (left_memory_id, left_revision, right_memory_id, right_revision, relation, source),
      CHECK (left_memory_id < right_memory_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"memory_qualifications","tbl_name":"memory_qualifications","sql":"CREATE TABLE memory_qualifications (
      memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version = 1),
      bound_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (bound_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
      content_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_digest) = 64 AND content_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      subject TEXT CHECK (subject IS NULL OR length(subject) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
      property TEXT CHECK (property IS NULL OR length(property) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
      scope TEXT CHECK (scope IS NULL OR length(scope) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
      applies TEXT CHECK (applies IS NULL OR length(applies) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
      value TEXT CHECK (value IS NULL OR length(value) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
      attribution TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (attribution IN ('direct','reported','quoted','proposed','unknown')),
      commitment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (commitment IN ('adopted','considered','rejected','unknown')),
      anchor_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (anchor_count BETWEEN 1 AND 4)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"memory_supersessions","tbl_name":"memory_supersessions","sql":"CREATE TABLE memory_supersessions (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('personal','project')),
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      previous_memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES memories(id),
      previous_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (previous_revision > 0),
      replacement_memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id),
      replacement_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (replacement_revision > 0),
      -- Four opaque 200-unit IDs, including worst-case JSON escaping/delimiters.
      receipt_ids TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(receipt_ids) <= 1613),
      CHECK (previous_memory_id != replacement_memory_id),
      CHECK ((scope = 'personal' AND project_id = '') OR
             (scope = 'project' AND length(project_id) > 0))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_binding_events","tbl_name":"method_binding_events","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_binding_events (
      event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('personal','project')), project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      package_id TEXT NOT NULL, role_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role_key='*' OR
        (length(role_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND role_key NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9._-]*')),
      kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind='binding_changed'),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0),
      state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','disabled')), version_id TEXT, manifest_identity TEXT,
      action_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      reason_refs TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(reason_refs) AND json_type(reason_refs)='array'
        AND json_array_length(reason_refs)<=16),
      ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(ordinal>0),
      CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)),
      CHECK((state='active' AND version_id IS NOT NULL AND manifest_identity IS NOT NULL) OR
        (state='disabled' AND version_id IS NULL AND manifest_identity IS NULL)),
      FOREIGN KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,package_id,role_key)
        REFERENCES method_bindings(owner_id,scope,project_id,package_id,role_key),
      FOREIGN KEY(package_id,version_id,manifest_identity)
        REFERENCES method_versions(package_id,id,manifest_identity)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_binding_generations","tbl_name":"method_binding_generations","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_binding_generations (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('personal','project')),
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL, package_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES method_packages(id),
      generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0),
      CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)),
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,package_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_bindings","tbl_name":"method_bindings","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_bindings (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('personal','project')),
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL, package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      role_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role_key='*' OR
        (length(role_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND role_key NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9._-]*')),
      state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','disabled')),
      version_id TEXT, manifest_identity TEXT,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)),
      CHECK((state='active' AND version_id IS NOT NULL AND manifest_identity IS NOT NULL) OR
        (state='disabled' AND version_id IS NULL AND manifest_identity IS NULL)),
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,package_id,role_key),
      FOREIGN KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,package_id)
        REFERENCES method_binding_generations(owner_id,scope,project_id,package_id),
      FOREIGN KEY(package_id,version_id,manifest_identity)
        REFERENCES method_versions(package_id,id,manifest_identity)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_changes","tbl_name":"method_changes","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_changes (
      to_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES method_versions(id), from_ref TEXT, to_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
      items TEXT NOT NULL, reason_refs TEXT NOT NULL
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_effects","tbl_name":"method_effects","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_effects (
      effect_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL, entity_type TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL, action_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_epochs","tbl_name":"method_epochs","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_epochs (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      generation INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_files","tbl_name":"method_files","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_files (
      version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES method_versions(id), position INTEGER NOT NULL,
      path TEXT NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_count>=0),
      content_identity TEXT NOT NULL, media_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(version_id,position), UNIQUE(version_id,path)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_manifest_formats","tbl_name":"method_manifest_formats","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_manifest_formats (
  version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES method_versions(id), format TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(format='mixed-v1')
 ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_mixed_entries","tbl_name":"method_mixed_entries","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_mixed_entries (
  version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES method_manifest_formats(version_id), position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position>=0 AND position<256),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('text','binary')), path TEXT NOT NULL, folded_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  media_type TEXT NOT NULL, content_identity TEXT NOT NULL, byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_count>=0),
  binary_object_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES binary_objects(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  PRIMARY KEY(version_id,position), UNIQUE(version_id,folded_path),
  CHECK((kind='text' AND binary_object_id IS NULL) OR (kind='binary' AND binary_object_id IS NOT NULL AND byte_count BETWEEN 1 AND 33554432))
 ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_operations","tbl_name":"method_operations","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_operations (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      action_id TEXT NOT NULL, method TEXT NOT NULL, payload_binding TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_id TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,action_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_owner_usage","tbl_name":"method_owner_usage","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_owner_usage (
      owner_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_count>=0)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_packages","tbl_name":"method_packages","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_packages (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('available','deleted')),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), next_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(next_ordinal>0),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"method_versions","tbl_name":"method_versions","sql":"CREATE TABLE method_versions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, package_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES method_packages(id),
      ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>0), based_on TEXT,
      manifest_identity TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('available','deleted')),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), title TEXT, submitted_by TEXT,
      imported_at TEXT NOT NULL, byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_count>=0),
      UNIQUE(package_id,ordinal),
      CHECK((state='available' AND title IS NOT NULL) OR
        (state='deleted' AND title IS NULL AND submitted_by IS NULL AND byte_count=0))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"moc_edges","tbl_name":"moc_edges","sql":"CREATE TABLE moc_edges (
      parent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mocs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      parent_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (parent_revision > 0),
      child_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mocs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      child_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (child_revision > 0),
      PRIMARY KEY (parent_id, child_id),
      CHECK (parent_id != child_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"moc_memory_refs","tbl_name":"moc_memory_refs","sql":"CREATE TABLE moc_memory_refs (
      moc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mocs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      moc_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (moc_revision > 0),
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      memory_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (memory_revision > 0),
      PRIMARY KEY (moc_id, memory_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"moc_title_sources","tbl_name":"moc_title_sources","sql":"CREATE TABLE moc_title_sources (
      moc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mocs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      memory_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (memory_revision > 0),
      PRIMARY KEY (moc_id, memory_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"mocs","tbl_name":"mocs","sql":"CREATE TABLE mocs (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('personal','project')),
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (level IN (1,2)),
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      canonical_title TEXT NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK ((scope = 'personal' AND project_id = '') OR
             (scope = 'project' AND length(project_id) > 0))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"namespace_epochs","tbl_name":"namespace_epochs","sql":"CREATE TABLE namespace_epochs (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('personal','project')),
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (epoch >= 1),
      PRIMARY KEY (owner_id, scope, project_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"namespace_index_state","tbl_name":"namespace_index_state","sql":"CREATE TABLE namespace_index_state (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      active_generation TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(owner_id, scope, project_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"private_cards","tbl_name":"private_cards","sql":"CREATE TABLE private_cards (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('draft','confirmed','cancelled','deleted')),
      title TEXT, body TEXT, body_revision INTEGER,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, confirmed_at TEXT,
      CHECK((state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND title IS NOT NULL AND body IS NOT NULL)
        OR (state IN ('cancelled','deleted') AND title IS NULL AND body IS NULL))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"procedural_tags","tbl_name":"procedural_tags","sql":"CREATE TABLE procedural_tags(memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES memories(id), tag_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tag_revision>0),
      positive INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(positive IN (0,1)), origin TEXT CHECK(origin IN ('model','explicit')), anchors TEXT) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"qualification_anchors","tbl_name":"qualification_anchors","sql":"CREATE TABLE qualification_anchors (
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_qualifications(memory_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal BETWEEN 0 AND 3),
      receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(id),
      receipt_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(receipt_digest) = 64 AND receipt_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      start INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (start BETWEEN 0 AND 799),
      end INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (end > start AND end <= 800 AND end - start <= 200),
      fields TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(fields) BETWEEN 2 AND 128),
      PRIMARY KEY (memory_id, ordinal)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"qualified_claim_bindings","tbl_name":"qualified_claim_bindings","sql":"CREATE TABLE qualified_claim_bindings (
      memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES memory_qualifications(memory_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qualified_slots(id),
      bound_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (bound_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
      content_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_digest) = 64 AND content_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      single_claim INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (single_claim = 1)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"qualified_slots","tbl_name":"qualified_slots","sql":"CREATE TABLE qualified_slots (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
      scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('personal','project')),
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(project_id) <= 200),
      subject TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(subject) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
      property TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(property) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
      claim_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(claim_scope) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
      applies TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(applies) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
      CHECK ((scope = 'personal' AND project_id = '') OR (scope = 'project' AND length(project_id) > 0))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"rationale_edges","tbl_name":"rationale_edges","sql":"CREATE TABLE rationale_edges (
      from_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      from_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(from_revision > 0),
      to_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      to_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(to_revision > 0),
      relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation IN ('supports-decision','challenges-premise')),
      from_receipt TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      to_receipt TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      from_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
      to_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK(from_id != to_id OR relation = 'supports-decision'),
      PRIMARY KEY(from_id, to_id, relation, from_receipt, to_receipt)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_capture_controls","tbl_name":"raw_capture_controls","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_capture_controls (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, client TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,client)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_capture_events","tbl_name":"raw_capture_events","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_capture_events (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      session_key TEXT NOT NULL, first_message_ids TEXT NOT NULL, eligible_message_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
      projection_digest TEXT NOT NULL, binding_digest TEXT NOT NULL, capture_generation TEXT NOT NULL,
      staging TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK(staging IN ('none','staged','not-staged')), local_target_id TEXT, local_store_id TEXT, local_consent_generation TEXT,
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id),
      FOREIGN KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id)
        REFERENCES raw_events(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_closed_jobs","tbl_name":"raw_closed_jobs","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_closed_jobs (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_conversations","tbl_name":"raw_conversations","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_conversations (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL, client TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(client IN ('claude-code','codex')),
      session_key TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
      first_received_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)),
      UNIQUE(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,session_key)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_deletion_actions","tbl_name":"raw_deletion_actions","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_deletion_actions (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      action_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload_binding TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,action_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_deletion_effects","tbl_name":"raw_deletion_effects","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_deletion_effects (
      ordinal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, effect_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_type IN ('conversation','episode')), source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      entity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entity_type IN ('conversation','episode','memory')), entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      action_id TEXT NOT NULL
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_events","tbl_name":"raw_events","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_events (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL,
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES raw_conversations(id), policy TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_exclusion_clocks","tbl_name":"raw_exclusion_clocks","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_exclusion_clocks (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0), PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_job_sources","tbl_name":"raw_job_sources","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_job_sources (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_client TEXT NOT NULL,
      session_key TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id,source_client,session_key,message_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_messages","tbl_name":"raw_messages","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_messages (
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES raw_conversations(id), message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>0), role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user','assistant')),
      occurred_at TEXT, total_units INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total_units>0), total_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total_bytes>0),
      next_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(next_index>=0), next_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(next_start>=0),
      received_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(received_bytes>=0),
      assembly_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(assembly_state IN ('pending','complete','closed')),
      reason TEXT CHECK(reason IN ('tool_off','notice_required','quota_reached','raw_disabled','capture_barrier')),
      reserved_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reserved_bytes>=0), first_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(conversation_id,message_id), UNIQUE(conversation_id,ordinal)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_owner_usage","tbl_name":"raw_owner_usage","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_owner_usage (
      owner_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(revision>=0),
      cap_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cap_bytes>0), saved_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(saved_bytes>=0),
      reserved_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reserved_bytes>=0)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_parts","tbl_name":"raw_parts","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_parts (
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL, part_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(part_index>=0),
      start INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start>=0), end INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(end>start),
      byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_count>0), digest TEXT NOT NULL,
      event_id TEXT NOT NULL, saved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(saved IN (0,1)),
      reason TEXT CHECK(reason IN ('tool_off','notice_required','quota_reached','raw_disabled','capture_barrier')),
      format TEXT CHECK(format IN ('local-plain-v1','envelope-aes-256-gcm-v1')), key_version TEXT, sealed BLOB,
      PRIMARY KEY(conversation_id,message_id,part_index),
      FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id,message_id) REFERENCES raw_messages(conversation_id,message_id),
      CHECK((saved=1 AND reason IS NULL AND format IS NOT NULL AND sealed IS NOT NULL)
        OR (saved=0 AND reason IS NOT NULL AND format IS NULL AND key_version IS NULL AND sealed IS NULL))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_receipt_lineage","tbl_name":"raw_receipt_lineage","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_receipt_lineage (
      receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES raw_conversations(id), message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      start INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start>=0), end INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(end>start),
      precision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(precision IN ('exact','whole-message')),
      PRIMARY KEY(receipt_id,conversation_id,message_id,start,end)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_receipt_origins","tbl_name":"raw_receipt_origins","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_receipt_origins (
      receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES receipts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('independent','derived','unknown'))
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_session_fences","tbl_name":"raw_session_fences","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_session_fences (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client TEXT NOT NULL, session_key TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,session_key)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_source_exclusions","tbl_name":"raw_source_exclusions","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_source_exclusions (
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES raw_conversations(id), message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      start INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start>=0), end INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(end>start),
      generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0), PRIMARY KEY(conversation_id,message_id,start,end)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"raw_source_maps","tbl_name":"raw_source_maps","sql":"CREATE TABLE raw_source_maps (
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES raw_conversations(id), message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_key TEXT NOT NULL, start INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start>=0), end INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(end>start),
      precision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(precision IN ('exact','whole-message')),
      PRIMARY KEY(conversation_id,message_id,source_key,start,end)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"receipt_causality","tbl_name":"receipt_causality","sql":"CREATE TABLE receipt_causality (
      receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES receipts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client TEXT NOT NULL, stream_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence > 0)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"receipts","tbl_name":"receipts","sql":"CREATE TABLE receipts (
      id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      receipt_key TEXT NOT NULL,
      client TEXT NOT NULL,
      session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user','assistant')),
      excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (memory_id, receipt_key)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"session_episodes","tbl_name":"session_episodes","sql":"CREATE TABLE session_episodes(
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client TEXT NOT NULL, session_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(session_key)=67 AND substr(session_key,1,3)='s1:' AND length(substr(session_key,4))=64 AND substr(session_key,4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
      source_fence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, generation TEXT NOT NULL, draft_every INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(draft_every BETWEEN 2 AND 16),
      deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(deleted IN (0,1)),
      observed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, attempted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, covered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      first_received_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(record)<=32768 AND json_valid(record))
        CHECK(coalesce(json_extract(record,'$.processing.state') IN ('pending','ready','incomplete','failed','invalidated'),0)), writer_token TEXT, writer_expires_at INTEGER,
      CHECK(scope IN ('personal','project')), CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR
  (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)), UNIQUE(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,session_key)) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"sqlite_sequence","tbl_name":"sqlite_sequence","sql":"CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)"},{"type":"table","name":"staged_capture_clocks","tbl_name":"staged_capture_clocks","sql":"CREATE TABLE staged_capture_clocks (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('personal','project')),
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      watermark INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (owner_id, scope, project_id)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"staged_capture_evidence","tbl_name":"staged_capture_evidence","sql":"CREATE TABLE staged_capture_evidence (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, client TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','failed','admitted','discarded','expired','forgotten','released')),
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT,
      payload_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(payload_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 131072),
      event_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staged-v1' CHECK(event_mode IN ('staged-v1','episode-v1')),
      release_reason TEXT CHECK(release_reason IN ('interpreted','capacity')),
      disposition INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(disposition IN (0,1)),
      PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id), CHECK(scope IN ('personal','project')), CHECK((scope='personal' AND project_id='') OR
  (scope='project' AND length(project_id)>0)),
      FOREIGN KEY(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id) REFERENCES admission_claims(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id),
      CHECK((payload IS NULL AND payload_bytes=0) OR (payload IS NOT NULL AND payload_bytes>0)),
      CHECK((state='released' AND event_mode='episode-v1' AND payload IS NULL AND payload_bytes=0 AND release_reason IS NOT NULL)
        OR (state!='released' AND release_reason IS NULL))) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"store_metadata","tbl_name":"store_metadata","sql":"CREATE TABLE store_metadata (
      singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
      store_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      cursor_secret TEXT NOT NULL
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"table","name":"suppressed","tbl_name":"suppressed","sql":"CREATE TABLE suppressed (
      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (owner_id, scope, project_id, fingerprint)
    ) STRICT"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_derivative_immutable","tbl_name":"asset_derivatives","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_derivative_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON asset_derivatives WHEN OLD.state='deleted' OR
  NEW.id!=OLD.id OR NEW.version_id!=OLD.version_id OR NEW.source_identity!=OLD.source_identity OR
  NEW.content_identity!=OLD.content_identity OR NEW.created_at!=OLD.created_at OR NEW.state!='deleted' OR NEW.revision!=OLD.revision+1
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_derivative_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_derivative_insert","tbl_name":"asset_derivatives","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_derivative_insert BEFORE INSERT ON asset_derivatives WHEN NEW.state!='available' OR NEW.revision!=1 OR
  NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asset_versions v JOIN assets a ON a.id=v.asset_id WHERE v.id=NEW.version_id AND
   v.content_identity=NEW.source_identity AND v.state='available' AND a.state='available') OR
  (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_derivatives WHERE version_id=NEW.version_id)>=32 OR
  NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asset_versions v JOIN assets a ON a.id=v.asset_id WHERE v.id=NEW.version_id AND
    json_extract(NEW.provenance,'$.source.assetId') IS a.id AND
    json_extract(NEW.provenance,'$.source.namespace.ownerId') IS a.owner_id AND
    json_extract(NEW.provenance,'$.source.namespace.scope') IS a.scope AND
    (json_type(NEW.provenance,'$.source.namespace.projectId') IS 'null' AND a.project_id='' OR
     json_extract(NEW.provenance,'$.source.namespace.projectId') IS a.project_id))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_parent_unavailable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_derivative_no_delete","tbl_name":"asset_derivatives","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_derivative_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON asset_derivatives BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_tombstone_required'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_derivative_no_replace","tbl_name":"asset_derivatives","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_derivative_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON asset_derivatives WHEN
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asset_derivatives WHERE id=NEW.id OR rowid=NEW.rowid)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_derivative_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_derivative_release","tbl_name":"asset_derivatives","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_derivative_release AFTER UPDATE OF state ON asset_derivatives WHEN OLD.state='available' AND NEW.state='deleted' BEGIN
  UPDATE binary_owner_usage SET byte_count=byte_count-OLD.byte_count WHERE owner_id=(SELECT a.owner_id FROM assets a JOIN asset_versions v ON v.asset_id=a.id WHERE v.id=OLD.version_id);
  INSERT INTO asset_epochs SELECT a.owner_id,a.scope,a.project_id,2 FROM assets a JOIN asset_versions v ON v.asset_id=a.id WHERE v.id=OLD.version_id
   ON CONFLICT(owner_id,scope,project_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=generation+1;
 END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_derivative_rowid_immutable","tbl_name":"asset_derivatives","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_derivative_rowid_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON asset_derivatives WHEN NEW.rowid!=OLD.rowid
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_derivative_rowid_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_derivative_timecodes","tbl_name":"asset_derivatives","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_derivative_timecodes BEFORE INSERT ON asset_derivatives WHEN NEW.timecodes IS NOT NULL AND (
  NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asset_versions WHERE id=NEW.version_id AND (media_type GLOB 'audio/*' OR media_type GLOB 'video/*')) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.timecodes) t WHERE json_type(t.value) IS NOT 'object' OR
   json_type(t.value,'$.startMs') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_type(t.value,'$.endMs') IS NOT 'integer' OR
   json_extract(t.value,'$.startMs')<0 OR json_extract(t.value,'$.endMs')<json_extract(t.value,'$.startMs') OR
   json_extract(t.value,'$.endMs')>9007199254740991 OR
   (CAST(t.key AS INTEGER)>0 AND json_extract(NEW.timecodes,'$['||(CAST(t.key AS INTEGER)-1)||'].endMs')>json_extract(t.value,'$.startMs'))))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid_asset_timecodes'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_identity_immutable","tbl_name":"assets","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON assets WHEN
  NEW.id!=OLD.id OR NEW.owner_id!=OLD.owner_id OR NEW.scope!=OLD.scope OR NEW.project_id!=OLD.project_id OR NEW.created_at!=OLD.created_at
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_lifecycle_epoch","tbl_name":"assets","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_lifecycle_epoch AFTER UPDATE OF state ON assets BEGIN
  INSERT INTO asset_epochs VALUES(NEW.owner_id,NEW.scope,NEW.project_id,2)
 ON CONFLICT(owner_id,scope,project_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=generation+1;
 END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_no_delete","tbl_name":"assets","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_tombstone_required'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_no_replace","tbl_name":"assets","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON assets WHEN NEW.state!='available' OR NEW.revision!=1 OR
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assets WHERE id=NEW.id OR rowid=NEW.rowid)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_terminal'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_purge","tbl_name":"assets","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_purge AFTER UPDATE OF state ON assets WHEN OLD.state='available' AND NEW.state='deleted' BEGIN
  UPDATE asset_versions SET state='deleted',revision=2,title=NULL,filename=NULL,media_type=NULL,byte_count=0,object_id=NULL WHERE asset_id=NEW.id AND state='available';
 END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_rowid_immutable","tbl_name":"assets","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_rowid_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON assets WHEN NEW.rowid!=OLD.rowid
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_rowid_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_terminal","tbl_name":"assets","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_terminal BEFORE UPDATE ON assets WHEN OLD.state='deleted'
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_terminal'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_version_epoch","tbl_name":"asset_versions","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_version_epoch AFTER INSERT ON asset_versions BEGIN
  INSERT INTO asset_epochs SELECT owner_id,scope,project_id,2 FROM assets WHERE id=NEW.asset_id
   ON CONFLICT(owner_id,scope,project_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=generation+1;
 END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_version_immutable","tbl_name":"asset_versions","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_version_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON asset_versions WHEN OLD.state='deleted' OR
  NEW.id!=OLD.id OR NEW.asset_id!=OLD.asset_id OR NEW.ordinal!=OLD.ordinal OR NEW.content_identity!=OLD.content_identity OR
  NEW.imported_at!=OLD.imported_at OR NEW.state!='deleted' OR NEW.revision!=OLD.revision+1
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_version_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_version_insert","tbl_name":"asset_versions","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_version_insert BEFORE INSERT ON asset_versions WHEN NEW.state!='available' OR NEW.revision!=1 OR
  NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assets WHERE id=NEW.asset_id AND state='available') OR
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM binary_objects WHERE id=NEW.object_id) OR
  (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_versions WHERE asset_id=NEW.asset_id)>=64
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_parent_unavailable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_version_no_delete","tbl_name":"asset_versions","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_version_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON asset_versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_tombstone_required'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_version_no_replace","tbl_name":"asset_versions","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_version_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON asset_versions WHEN
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asset_versions WHERE id=NEW.id OR rowid=NEW.rowid OR (asset_id=NEW.asset_id AND ordinal=NEW.ordinal))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_version_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_version_purge","tbl_name":"asset_versions","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_version_purge AFTER UPDATE OF state ON asset_versions WHEN OLD.state='available' AND NEW.state='deleted' BEGIN
  DELETE FROM binary_objects WHERE asset_version_id=NEW.id;
  UPDATE asset_derivatives SET state='deleted',revision=2,kind=NULL,text=NULL,provenance=NULL,language=NULL,timecodes=NULL,byte_count=0
   WHERE version_id=NEW.id AND state='available';
 END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"asset_version_rowid_immutable","tbl_name":"asset_versions","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER asset_version_rowid_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON asset_versions WHEN NEW.rowid!=OLD.rowid
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'asset_version_rowid_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"binary_chunk_immutable","tbl_name":"binary_chunks","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER binary_chunk_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON binary_chunks BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'binary_chunk_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"binary_chunk_no_replace","tbl_name":"binary_chunks","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER binary_chunk_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON binary_chunks WHEN
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM binary_chunks WHERE rowid=NEW.rowid OR (object_id=NEW.object_id AND chunk_index=NEW.chunk_index))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'binary_chunk_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"binary_chunk_shape","tbl_name":"binary_chunks","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER binary_chunk_shape BEFORE INSERT ON binary_chunks WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM binary_objects o
  WHERE o.id=NEW.object_id AND NEW.chunk_index*32768<o.byte_count AND
   length(NEW.bytes)=min(32768,o.byte_count-NEW.chunk_index*32768))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid_binary_chunk'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"binary_object_immutable","tbl_name":"binary_objects","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER binary_object_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON binary_objects BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'binary_object_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"binary_object_no_replace","tbl_name":"binary_objects","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER binary_object_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON binary_objects WHEN
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM binary_objects WHERE id=NEW.id OR rowid=NEW.rowid OR asset_version_id=NEW.asset_version_id OR
   (method_version_id=NEW.method_version_id AND position=NEW.position))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'binary_object_immutable'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"binary_object_owner","tbl_name":"binary_objects","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER binary_object_owner BEFORE INSERT ON binary_objects WHEN
  (NEW.asset_version_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asset_versions v JOIN assets a ON a.id=v.asset_id
   WHERE v.id=NEW.asset_version_id AND v.object_id=NEW.id AND a.state='available' AND v.state='available' AND
    a.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND a.scope=NEW.scope AND a.project_id=NEW.project_id AND
    v.content_identity=NEW.content_identity AND v.media_type=NEW.media_type AND v.byte_count=NEW.byte_count)) OR
  (NEW.method_version_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method_versions v JOIN method_packages p ON p.id=v.package_id
   JOIN method_mixed_entries e ON e.version_id=v.id AND e.position=NEW.position WHERE v.id=NEW.method_version_id AND
    v.state='available' AND p.state='available' AND p.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND p.scope=NEW.scope AND p.project_id=NEW.project_id AND
    e.kind='binary' AND e.binary_object_id=NEW.id AND e.content_identity=NEW.content_identity AND e.media_type=NEW.media_type AND e.byte_count=NEW.byte_count))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid_binary_owner'); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"binary_object_release","tbl_name":"binary_objects","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER binary_object_release AFTER DELETE ON binary_objects BEGIN
  UPDATE binary_owner_usage SET byte_count=byte_count-OLD.byte_count WHERE owner_id=OLD.owner_id;
  INSERT INTO asset_epochs VALUES(OLD.owner_id,OLD.scope,OLD.project_id,2)
 ON CONFLICT(owner_id,scope,project_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=generation+1;
 END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"card_memory_purge","tbl_name":"private_cards","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER card_memory_purge AFTER UPDATE OF state ON private_cards
      WHEN NEW.state IN ('cancelled','deleted')
    BEGIN
      DELETE FROM card_bindings WHERE card_id=NEW.id;
      DELETE FROM card_memory_bindings WHERE card_id=NEW.id;
    END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"card_memory_revision_invalidation","tbl_name":"memories","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER card_memory_revision_invalidation AFTER UPDATE OF revision ON memories
      WHEN OLD.revision!=NEW.revision AND EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings WHERE memory_id=OLD.id)
    BEGIN
      SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM private_cards c JOIN card_memory_bindings b ON b.card_id=c.id
        WHERE b.memory_id=OLD.id AND c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope
          AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') LIMIT 129
      ))>128 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'card_dependency_limit_reached') END;
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO card_raw_pending_invalidations(card_id,revision)
      SELECT DISTINCT c.id,c.revision FROM card_memory_bindings b INDEXED BY card_memory_dependents
      CROSS JOIN private_cards c ON c.id=b.card_id
      WHERE b.memory_id=OLD.id AND c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id
        AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_mutation_context x WHERE x.owner_id=c.owner_id AND x.scope=c.scope AND x.project_id=c.project_id)
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_bindings r WHERE r.card_id=c.id);
      SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM (
        SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_pending_invalidations LIMIT 129
      ))>128 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'card_dependency_limit_reached') END;
      INSERT INTO card_effects
        (effect_id,owner_id,scope,project_id,kind,entity_type,entity_id,revision,action_id,ordinal)
      SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),c.owner_id,c.scope,c.project_id,
        'evidence_invalidated','card',c.id,c.revision+1,
        'memory-revision-'||OLD.id||'-'||NEW.revision,
        (SELECT coalesce(max(ordinal),0) FROM card_effects)+row_number() OVER(ORDER BY c.id)
      FROM private_cards c WHERE c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope
        AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_pending_invalidations p WHERE p.card_id=c.id) AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings b WHERE b.card_id=c.id AND b.memory_id=OLD.id);
      INSERT INTO card_epochs(owner_id,scope,project_id,generation)
      SELECT OLD.owner_id,OLD.scope,OLD.project_id,2
      WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_mutation_context x WHERE x.owner_id=OLD.owner_id
        AND x.scope=OLD.scope AND x.project_id=OLD.project_id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings b INDEXED BY card_memory_dependents
          CROSS JOIN private_cards c ON c.id=b.card_id WHERE b.memory_id=OLD.id AND c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope
          AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_pending_invalidations p WHERE p.card_id=c.id)
        )
      ON CONFLICT(owner_id,scope,project_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=generation+1;
      UPDATE private_cards SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=NEW.updated_at,
        title=CASE WHEN state='draft' THEN NULL ELSE title END,
        body=CASE WHEN state='draft' THEN NULL ELSE body END,
        state=CASE WHEN state='draft' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE state END
      WHERE owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND scope=OLD.scope AND project_id=OLD.project_id
        AND state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_pending_invalidations p WHERE p.card_id=private_cards.id) AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings b WHERE b.card_id=private_cards.id AND b.memory_id=OLD.id);
      
    END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"card_moc_card_insert","tbl_name":"private_cards","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER card_moc_card_insert AFTER INSERT ON private_cards BEGIN
      INSERT INTO card_moc_epochs VALUES(NEW.owner_id,NEW.scope,NEW.project_id,2)
        ON CONFLICT(owner_id,scope,project_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=revision+1;
    END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"card_moc_card_update","tbl_name":"private_cards","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER card_moc_card_update AFTER UPDATE OF revision,state ON private_cards
      WHEN NEW.revision!=OLD.revision OR NEW.state!=OLD.state BEGIN
      INSERT INTO card_moc_epochs VALUES(NEW.owner_id,NEW.scope,NEW.project_id,2)
        ON CONFLICT(owner_id,scope,project_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=revision+1;
    END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"card_raw_purge","tbl_name":"private_cards","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER card_raw_purge AFTER UPDATE OF state ON private_cards
      WHEN NEW.state IN ('cancelled','deleted') BEGIN
      DELETE FROM card_raw_bindings WHERE card_id=NEW.id;
    END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_memories_delete","tbl_name":"memories","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_memories_delete AFTER DELETE ON memories BEGIN DELETE FROM index_memories WHERE id = OLD.id
      AND generation IN (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = OLD.owner_id AND s.scope = OLD.scope AND s.project_id = OLD.project_id); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_memories_insert","tbl_name":"memories","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_memories_insert AFTER INSERT ON memories BEGIN INSERT OR REPLACE INTO index_memories(generation,id,revision)
      SELECT (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = r.owner_id AND s.scope = r.scope AND s.project_id = r.project_id),r.id,r.revision
      FROM memories r WHERE r.id = NEW.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.currentness = 'current' AND r.review_state != 'awaiting' AND (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = r.owner_id AND s.scope = r.scope AND s.project_id = r.project_id) IS NOT NULL; END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_memories_update","tbl_name":"memories","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_memories_update AFTER UPDATE ON memories BEGIN UPDATE index_memories SET id = NEW.id,revision = NEW.revision
      WHERE id = OLD.id AND generation IN
        (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = OLD.owner_id AND s.scope = OLD.scope AND s.project_id = OLD.project_id);
      DELETE FROM index_memories WHERE id = NEW.id
        AND generation IN (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = OLD.owner_id AND s.scope = OLD.scope AND s.project_id = OLD.project_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memories r WHERE r.id = NEW.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.currentness = 'current' AND r.review_state != 'awaiting');INSERT OR REPLACE INTO index_memories(generation,id,revision)
      SELECT (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = r.owner_id AND s.scope = r.scope AND s.project_id = r.project_id),r.id,r.revision
      FROM memories r WHERE OLD.review_state = 'awaiting' AND NEW.review_state != 'awaiting' AND r.id = NEW.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.currentness = 'current' AND r.review_state != 'awaiting' AND (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = r.owner_id AND s.scope = r.scope AND s.project_id = r.project_id) IS NOT NULL; END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_moc_edges_delete","tbl_name":"moc_edges","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_edges_delete AFTER DELETE ON moc_edges BEGIN DELETE FROM index_edges WHERE parent_id = OLD.parent_id AND child_id = OLD.child_id
      AND generation IN (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.parent_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN mocs c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.child_id); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_moc_edges_insert","tbl_name":"moc_edges","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_edges_insert AFTER INSERT ON moc_edges BEGIN INSERT OR REPLACE INTO index_edges(generation,parent_id,child_id,parent_revision,child_revision)
      SELECT (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id),r.parent_id,r.child_id,r.parent_revision,r.child_revision
      FROM moc_edges r JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.parent_id JOIN mocs c ON c.id = r.child_id WHERE r.parent_id = NEW.parent_id AND r.child_id = NEW.child_id AND p.owner_id = c.owner_id AND p.scope = c.scope AND p.project_id = c.project_id AND p.level = 2 AND c.level = 1 AND p.revision = r.parent_revision AND c.revision = r.child_revision AND (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id) IS NOT NULL; END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_moc_edges_update","tbl_name":"moc_edges","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_edges_update AFTER UPDATE ON moc_edges BEGIN UPDATE index_edges SET parent_id = NEW.parent_id,child_id = NEW.child_id,parent_revision = NEW.parent_revision,child_revision = NEW.child_revision
      WHERE parent_id = OLD.parent_id AND child_id = OLD.child_id AND generation IN
        (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.parent_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN mocs c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.child_id);
      DELETE FROM index_edges WHERE parent_id = NEW.parent_id AND child_id = NEW.child_id
        AND generation IN (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.parent_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN mocs c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.child_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moc_edges r JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.parent_id JOIN mocs c ON c.id = r.child_id WHERE r.parent_id = NEW.parent_id AND r.child_id = NEW.child_id AND p.owner_id = c.owner_id AND p.scope = c.scope AND p.project_id = c.project_id AND p.level = 2 AND c.level = 1 AND p.revision = r.parent_revision AND c.revision = r.child_revision); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_moc_memory_refs_delete","tbl_name":"moc_memory_refs","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_memory_refs_delete AFTER DELETE ON moc_memory_refs BEGIN DELETE FROM index_memory_refs WHERE moc_id = OLD.moc_id AND memory_id = OLD.memory_id
      AND generation IN (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.moc_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN memories c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.memory_id); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_moc_memory_refs_insert","tbl_name":"moc_memory_refs","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_memory_refs_insert AFTER INSERT ON moc_memory_refs BEGIN INSERT OR REPLACE INTO index_memory_refs(generation,moc_id,memory_id,moc_revision,memory_revision)
      SELECT (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id),r.moc_id,r.memory_id,r.moc_revision,r.memory_revision
      FROM moc_memory_refs r JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.moc_id JOIN memories c ON c.id = r.memory_id WHERE r.moc_id = NEW.moc_id AND r.memory_id = NEW.memory_id AND p.owner_id = c.owner_id AND p.scope = c.scope AND p.project_id = c.project_id AND p.level = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 AND p.revision = r.moc_revision AND c.revision = r.memory_revision AND c.currentness = 'current' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memories h WHERE h.id=r.memory_id AND h.review_state='awaiting') AND (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id) IS NOT NULL; END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_moc_memory_refs_update","tbl_name":"moc_memory_refs","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_memory_refs_update AFTER UPDATE ON moc_memory_refs BEGIN UPDATE index_memory_refs SET moc_id = NEW.moc_id,memory_id = NEW.memory_id,moc_revision = NEW.moc_revision,memory_revision = NEW.memory_revision
      WHERE moc_id = OLD.moc_id AND memory_id = OLD.memory_id AND generation IN
        (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.moc_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN memories c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.memory_id);
      DELETE FROM index_memory_refs WHERE moc_id = NEW.moc_id AND memory_id = NEW.memory_id
        AND generation IN (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.moc_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN memories c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.memory_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moc_memory_refs r JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.moc_id JOIN memories c ON c.id = r.memory_id WHERE r.moc_id = NEW.moc_id AND r.memory_id = NEW.memory_id AND p.owner_id = c.owner_id AND p.scope = c.scope AND p.project_id = c.project_id AND p.level = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 AND p.revision = r.moc_revision AND c.revision = r.memory_revision AND c.currentness = 'current' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memories h WHERE h.id=r.memory_id AND h.review_state='awaiting')); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_moc_title_sources_delete","tbl_name":"moc_title_sources","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_title_sources_delete AFTER DELETE ON moc_title_sources BEGIN DELETE FROM index_title_sources WHERE moc_id = OLD.moc_id AND memory_id = OLD.memory_id
      AND generation IN (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.moc_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN memories c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.memory_id); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_moc_title_sources_insert","tbl_name":"moc_title_sources","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_title_sources_insert AFTER INSERT ON moc_title_sources BEGIN INSERT OR REPLACE INTO index_title_sources(generation,moc_id,memory_id,memory_revision)
      SELECT (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id),r.moc_id,r.memory_id,r.memory_revision
      FROM moc_title_sources r JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.moc_id JOIN memories c ON c.id = r.memory_id WHERE r.moc_id = NEW.moc_id AND r.memory_id = NEW.memory_id AND p.owner_id = c.owner_id AND p.scope = c.scope AND p.project_id = c.project_id AND p.level IN (1,2) AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.revision = r.memory_revision AND c.currentness = 'current' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memories h WHERE h.id=r.memory_id AND h.review_state='awaiting') AND (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id) IS NOT NULL; END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_moc_title_sources_update","tbl_name":"moc_title_sources","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_title_sources_update AFTER UPDATE ON moc_title_sources BEGIN UPDATE index_title_sources SET moc_id = NEW.moc_id,memory_id = NEW.memory_id,memory_revision = NEW.memory_revision
      WHERE moc_id = OLD.moc_id AND memory_id = OLD.memory_id AND generation IN
        (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.moc_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN memories c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.memory_id);
      DELETE FROM index_title_sources WHERE moc_id = NEW.moc_id AND memory_id = NEW.memory_id
        AND generation IN (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.moc_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN memories c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.memory_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moc_title_sources r JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.moc_id JOIN memories c ON c.id = r.memory_id WHERE r.moc_id = NEW.moc_id AND r.memory_id = NEW.memory_id AND p.owner_id = c.owner_id AND p.scope = c.scope AND p.project_id = c.project_id AND p.level IN (1,2) AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.revision = r.memory_revision AND c.currentness = 'current' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memories h WHERE h.id=r.memory_id AND h.review_state='awaiting')); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_mocs_delete","tbl_name":"mocs","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_mocs_delete AFTER DELETE ON mocs BEGIN DELETE FROM index_mocs WHERE id = OLD.id
      AND generation IN (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = OLD.owner_id AND s.scope = OLD.scope AND s.project_id = OLD.project_id); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_mocs_insert","tbl_name":"mocs","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_mocs_insert AFTER INSERT ON mocs BEGIN INSERT OR REPLACE INTO index_mocs(generation,id,revision)
      SELECT (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = r.owner_id AND s.scope = r.scope AND s.project_id = r.project_id),r.id,r.revision
      FROM mocs r WHERE r.id = NEW.id AND r.level IN (1,2) AND (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = r.owner_id AND s.scope = r.scope AND s.project_id = r.project_id) IS NOT NULL; END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"index_mocs_update","tbl_name":"mocs","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER index_mocs_update AFTER UPDATE ON mocs BEGIN UPDATE index_mocs SET id = NEW.id,revision = NEW.revision
      WHERE id = OLD.id AND generation IN
        (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = OLD.owner_id AND s.scope = OLD.scope AND s.project_id = OLD.project_id);
      DELETE FROM index_mocs WHERE id = NEW.id
        AND generation IN (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = OLD.owner_id AND s.scope = OLD.scope AND s.project_id = OLD.project_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mocs r WHERE r.id = NEW.id AND r.level IN (1,2)); END"},{"type":"trigger","name":"local_capture_binding_insert","tbl_name":"raw_capture_events","sql":"CREATE TRIGGER local_capture_binding_insert BEFORE INSERT ON raw_capture_events
